# Microsoft Excel Online

> > Microsoft Excel's online platform offering free customizable spreadsheet templates, AI-powered Copilot integration, and collaborative tools for project management, budgeting, and data visualization.

Excel.cloud.microsoft provides web-based access to Excel templates and tools across multiple languages, featuring Gantt charts, budget planners, calendars, and graph makers. The platform integrates Copilot AI assistance for enhanced productivity in business, personal finance, student work, and project planning scenarios.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Excel

## Project Management & Planning

- [Project management | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/en/project-management): Project management templates with Gantt charts, Copilot AI & task tracking
- [プロジェクト管理 | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/ja/project-management): Project management templates with Gantt charts & Copilot AI integration
- [Kostenlose, anpassbare Gantt-Diagrammvorlagen online | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/de/gantt-charts): Gantt chart templates for project timeline & task tracking in Excel
- [Modèles gratuits de planification de projet et de listes de tâches en ligne | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/fr/project-planning-to-do-lists): Project planning & to-do list templates with Gantt charts & collaboration
- [Бесплатные шаблоны планирования проектов и списков дел в Интернете | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/ru/project-planning-to-do-lists): Project planning & to-do list templates with Gantt chart collaboration

## Business & Financial Tools

- [Pianificazione del budget aziendale: modificare e condividere online | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/it/business-budgeting): Business budget planning templates with Copilot assistance in Excel
- [Бесплатный веб-конструктор бизнес-таблиц с редактируемыми шаблонами | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/ru/business-spreadsheets): Business spreadsheet templates for budgets, expenses & accounting
- [Meine Finanzen-Tracker: Online bearbeiten und teilen | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/de/personal-finance): Personal finance tracker for household budgets & expense tracking
- [免费的在线个人预算规划器模板 | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/zh-hans/personal-budget-planner): Personal budget planner for monthly income/expense tracking with Copilot

## Templates & Resources

- [Modelli gratuiti di fogli di calcolo Excel | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/it/templates): Excel template library for budgets, projects, inventory & Gantt charts
- [Бесплатные электронные таблицы для учащихся и отслеживание заданий | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/ru/student-templates): Student templates for assignments, schedules, grades & academic planning

## Data Visualization & Productivity Tools

- [Creador gratuito de gráficos en línea | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/es/graph-maker): Graph maker for data visualization with charts & Copilot integration
- [Gratis agendamaker online met aanpasbare sjablonen | Microsoft Excel](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/nl/calendar-maker): Calendar maker with weekly/monthly/yearly templates & Copilot integration

## Excel Blog & Insights

- [Excel Blog](https://excel.cloud.microsoft/create/de/blog): Excel blog featuring AI spreadsheets, Copilot & formula tutorials
